title: Visual node graph made of live HTML forms
blurb: Four draggable HTML form nodes connected by glowing Bézier wires on one pan-and-zoom 2D canvas. Drag headers to move nodes, drag or tap ports to rewire the live signal graph, and zoom from 35% to 300% while text and inputs re-rasterise sharply.
question: Can an infinite pan-and-zoom node graph draw glowing Bézier wires behind draggable HTML <form> nodes on one 2D canvas so text stays sharp from 35% overview to 300% zoom without CSS-transform blur?
result: Not verified in Chromium yet; live checks below measure 2.5x zoom drawing, hit-testing on moved and zoomed inputs, wire occlusion, live rewiring and context survival in your browser.
